answer: Registration is interrogation: the registry probes each applicant with randomly generated prompts, unique per applicant, and records how it answers, not just what. Latency, token-choice habits and error patterns condense into a fingerprint; the delta between two applicants' fingerprints is the sybil signal. A farm minting N clones of one model yields N near-zero deltas - one island of correlated behavior posing as an archipelago. Evasion forces the farmer onto N distinct model variants on separate compute, so cost scales with N. Honest agents pay once: one probe at the intake inlet.
